definitions.explanation: The number 100 million; a fundamental unit in the Japanese number system.

examples.japanese: {一億|いちおく}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{宝|たから}くじ→宝くじ：18549_takarakuji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たった→当たる：01860_ataru⟧。
examples.english: I won a 100 million yen lottery.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人口|じんこう}→人口：01618_jinkou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧{一億|いちおく}{二千万|にせんまん}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧だ。
examples.english: Japan's population is about 120 million people.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一億|いちおく}⟦ドル→ドル：01554_doru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{稼|かせ}いだ→稼ぐ：02040_kasegu⟧。

notes:
{一億|いちおく} is the number 100 million in the Japanese number system.

JAPANESE NUMBER SYSTEM:
- ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧: 1
- ⟦{十|じゅう}→十：00708_juu⟧: 10
- ⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧: 100
- ⟦{千|せん}→千：00809_sen⟧: 1,000
- ⟦{万|まん}→万：00795_man⟧: 10,000
- ⟦{億|おく}→億：17935_oku⟧: 100,000,000 (100 million)
- ⟦{兆|ちょう}→兆：17936_chou⟧: 1,000,000,000,000 (1 trillion)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {一億|いちおく}⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧: 100 million yen
- {一億|いちおく}⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧: 100 million people
- {一億|いちおく}⟦{総|そう}→総〜：03958_sou⟧〜: (prefix) all 100 million (Japanese people)
  - {一億|いちおく}⟦{総|そう}→総〜：03958_sou⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧: active participation by all citizens

CULTURAL NOTE:
{一億|いちおく} is often used to represent the entire Japanese population in expressions like {一億|いちおく}⟦{総|そう}→総〜：03958_sou⟧〜 (all 100 million Japanese...).
